The SDK may still contact the Fylar licensing service to validate credentials a"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"nd meter usage as described in the commercial license.
- **No iframe, just a DOM node** — integratio"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"n is a programmable DOM node instead of an embedded external viewer.
- **High-fidelity compatibility"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"** — built around the Office (OOXML) specification to preserve layout, formatting, and document beha"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"vior, with pixel-perfect rendering wherever possible.
